_about: The Morning Exercises, the London Puritan lecture series of 1659-1689: The Morning Exercises at Cripplegate, St Giles in the Fields, and in Southwark, fifth edition, carefully collated and corrected, with notes and translations by James Nichols (London: Thomas Tegg, 1844-1845, in six volumes), vols.
